limitations: Restricted to same-space operators on \(\ell_p(G)\), \(1\le p<\infty\), and \(c_0(G)\); no \(\ell_\infty(G)\) claim. No claim that every operator is convolution by an \(\ell_1\) kernel. The closest 2024 paper was not exhaustively available at theorem level.

prior_scientific_review_evidence.correctness: The prior review uses disjoint translated input/output blocks, an explicit norm-one projection, finite-codimensional intersections, and a quotient tail argument to obtain the four flat s-number profiles and ideal distances.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.originality: The prior review treats maximal noncompactness on \(\mathbb Z^d\) as prior art and limits novelty to the all-\(n\) strict s-number profile, strict-singular distances, and complemented witness on arbitrary infinite discrete groups.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.value: The prior review identifies exact determination of four s-number scales and a reusable complemented-subspace mechanism as the mathematical value.

provenance: A disjoint-translate argument produces a complemented classical sequence subspace on which a translation-invariant operator is bounded below arbitrarily close to its full norm.
record_title: Flat s-number profile for translation-invariant operators on sequence spaces
